2790-8229.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 5.
Loki, Lord of Misrule does not have summoning sickness.
Angel of Destiny does not have summoning sickness.
2790-8229.notablePrerequisites:
You control three other creatures that do not have summoning sickness.
Opponents cannot block flying creatures you control.
2790-8229.description:
Activate Loki by paying {U} and tapping it, targeting Angel of Destiny and making each other creature you control into a nonlegendary copy of the targeted creature until end of turn.
Move to combat and declare all your Angels as attackers, sending at least one Angel at each opponent.
When first strike damage is dealt, each Angel of Destiny you control triggers for each creature that dealt damage.
Resolve each trigger, causing each opponent to gain life equal to X times the damage they took (where X is the number of Angels you control) and you to gain life equal to that combined total.
Repeat steps 4-5 for the normal damage step.
At the beginning of your end step, since your life total is at least 45, each Angel of Destiny you control triggers, causing the player it attacked to lose the game.

2137-4642-5295.description:
Cast Awaken the Woods with X equal to 3 by paying {3}{G}{G}.
Holding priority, activate Uyo by paying {2} and returning two lands you control to their owner's hand, copying Awaken the Woods.
Resolve the copy of Awaken the Woods, creating three 1/1 Forest Dryad land creature tokens.
Activate two Forest Dryads by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.
2137-4642-5295.notes: Once you have infinite green mana and infinite land tokens, you may activate Uyo any number of times, targeting any number of instant or sorcery spells.

4591-7074-8089.description:
Activate Koh by paying life.
Repeat step 1 until you have 0 life.
Cast Mister Negative by paying {5}{W}{B} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Mister Negative enters, it triggers, swapping your life total with an opponent's.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 life.

620-3532-5078-7913.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
620-3532-5078-7913.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Yotian Dissident triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Yotian Dissident.
Repeat.

489-1090-6867-6967.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Restoration Angel with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Restoration Angel from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Restoration Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

789-2946-4871-6797.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
789-2946-4871-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Gutter Grime trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2590-5776-7313-7730.description:
Activate another creature you control, which is a Food due to Ygra, by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Ygra and Experimental Confectioner trigger.
Resolve the Ygra trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Experimental Confectioner trigger, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Repeat.

1368-6321-7297-7763.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-6321-7297-7763.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 2 or greater

460-539-7308.description:
Activate Mona Lisa by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Scryb Ranger by returning it from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Mona Lisa.
Cast Scryb Ranger by paying {1}{G}.
Repeat.

140-586-3967-5258-5618.description:
Activate Rowan by tapping it.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Yahenni ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat from step 2

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

1233-1322-3259.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1233-1322-3259.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Squee as attackers.
Squee triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2478-4195-4574-5849.description:
Activate Mishra's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Ich-Tekik's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and each Golem you control.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Mishra's Bauble from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Mishra's Bauble from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat.

2751-4067-6921.easyPrerequisites:
Biorganic Carapace is attached to a creature you control that does not have summoning sickness and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
You control a mana-producing permanent.
2751-4067-6921.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three modified creatures.
2751-4067-6921.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature that has Biorganic Carapace attached, triggering it.
Holding priority, activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying the creature's trigger.
Resolve the copy of the creature's ability, drawing a card for each modified creature you control.
Holding priority, activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Strionic Resonator.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping a mana-producing permanent.
Activate the mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat from step 5 one additional time.
Repeat from step 2.
2751-4067-6921.notes: Depending on how many modified creatures you control, you may draw more cards than is needed to continue the loop. You can choose to keep those cards or discard them for additional results.

4487-5220-6247.description:
Cast Phyrexian Marauder by paying {0}.
Phyrexian Marauder enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Mortuary and High-Society Hunter.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Phyrexian Marauder from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the High-Society Hunter trigger, causing you to draw a card, thus drawing Phyrexian Marauder from your library.
Repeat.

2946-4050-5631.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
2946-4050-5631.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Cult Conscript, adding {B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Skeleton Crew triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature tokens, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2034-2423-4679-6821.description:
Cast Jump Scare by paying {W}, targeting Bounding Krasis.
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Bounding Krasis.
When the Bounding Krasis token enters, it triggers, untapping Yenna.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Bounding Krasis token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

856-5632-5776-6798.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Chalk Outline trigger.
Resolve the Chalk Outline trigger, creating a creature token and a Clue token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

2661-3692-6000.description:
Activate Gwenna by tapping it, adding {U}{U} that can only be spent to cast creature spells or activate abilities of creatures.
Cast Aethersnipe for its evoke cost by paying {U}{U}.
Gwenna triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and untapping it.
When Aethersnipe enters the battlefield, its first ability and evoke ability trigger.
Resolve the first Aethersnipe trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the second Aethersnipe trigger, failing to sacrifice it as it is no longer on the battlefield.
Repeat.

440-1339-1496-4050.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
440-1339-1496-4050.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, Verdant Sun's Avatar triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Well of Lost Dreams triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Insect, adding {1}.
Resolve the Well of Lost Dreams trigger, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Matzalantli, the Great Door // The Core

478-804-2821-3088-6071.notablePrerequisites: You have at least four permanent cards in your graveyard.
478-804-2821-3088-6071.description:
Animate Candelabra using Xenic Poltergeist.
Cast Sakashima the Impostor by paying {2}{U}{U}. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Candelabra of Tawnos that is still named Sakashima the Impostor and legendary.
Activate The Core by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Sakashima the Impostor by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping Minamo and The Core.
Activate Minamo's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Sakashima the Impostor.
Repeat from step 3.

2506-6180.description:
Cast Boggart Mob by paying its mana cost.
When Boggart Mob enters the battlefield, its champion ability and Molten Echoes triggers.
Resolve the Molten Echoes trigger, creating a token copy of Boggart Mob with haste.
When the Boggart Mob token enters the battlefiled, its champion ability triggers, exiling the nontoken Boggart Mob until the token Boggart Mob leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the champion ability from step 2, exiling the token Boggart Mob.
The token Boggart Mob leaves the battlefield, returning the nontoken Boggart Mob from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

413-2178-5470.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Ghired.
You control at least one creature token that entered the battlefield this turn.
413-2178-5470.description:
Activate Ghired by tapping it, creating a token copy of any creature token you control that entered the battlefield this turn.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature token.
When the token dies, Ghired triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

4613-4802-5507.notablePrerequisites: You control another creature that has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
4613-4802-5507.description:
Activate another creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it by exiling it, creating a 1/1 Human creature token that enters the battlefield with at least two +1/+1 counters on it due to Master Biomancer.
Repeat using the Human token instead.

2034-2127-5189.notablePrerequisites: A creature you control has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
2034-2127-5189.description:
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
When the Saproling enters the battlefield, Tribute to the World Tree triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on the Saproling.
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Saproling, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Ghave ability, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Saproling tokens, and you may either use the remaining +1/+1 counters for Ghave's first ability and/or sacrifice the Saprolings to Ghave's second ability.

703-2097-2232-2972-5184.description:
Cast Astral Dragon by paying {6}{U}{U}.
When Astral Dragon enters the battlefield, it, Ganax and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing to return nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the Astral Dragon trigger, creating two copies of any noncreature nonartifact permanent that are 3/3 Dragons.
When the Dragons enter the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio and Ganax each trigger twice.
Resolve the first Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Astral Dragon from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the second Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing to return nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve all Ganax triggers, creating nine Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate eight Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {6}{U}{U}.
Repeat.

850-2645.notablePrerequisites: Overgrown Battlement does not have summoning sickness. You control at least five creatures with defender.
850-2645.description:
Activate Overgrown Battlement by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Overgrown Battlement.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
850-2645.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Staff of Domination's other abilities.

465-624-1430.description:
Cast Mirror Image by paying {2}{U}, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Wormfang Drake.
When Mirror Image enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Wormfang Drake.
When Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Phantasmal Image to the battlefield as a copy of Mirror Image, thus making it a copy of Wormfang Drake.
When Phantasmal Image enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Mirror Image.
When Mirror Image leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from exile to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Phantasmal Image.
When Phantasmal Image leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Mirror Image to the battlefield as a copy of Wormfang Drake.
Repeat from step 2.

364-614-1987-5116.description:
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Gilded Lotus and Nucklavee, blinking them.
When Nucklavee enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
Repeat.
